Idle.note: Idle means halted with no outstanding requests.

NotStarted.note: No pre-start state; Workflow::run and run_stream start immediately and first report Started.

PendingRequests.note: IdleWithPendingRequests means halted awaiting external responses.

Running.note: InProgress (or InProgressPendingRequests) means the run is processing supersteps.

ExecutorId.note: No scope identity; SharedState keys are not attributed to executors.

ScopeName.note: No named shared scopes in SharedState.

Equals(object?).note: No scope identity type to compare.

mapping.note: No scope/key pair; SharedState is addressed by a plain String key.

Key.note: State entries are addressed by a plain String key on SharedState, without a scope.

ScopeId.note: No scope component on SharedState keys.

Equals(object?).note: No scope/key type; keys are plain Strings compared by value.

mapping.note: Executors persist state via snapshot_state/restore_state into checkpoints; no options type binding state to a key and scope.

StateKey.note: No configurable state key; executor state is checkpointed by executor id.

mapping.note: WorkflowRunStream is a futures Stream of WorkflowEvents for a running workflow.

SessionId.note: Streaming runs carry no session id.

CancelRunAsync().note: No cancel operation; dropping the stream detaches the spawned run task rather than stopping it, and WorkflowRunState::Cancelled is never set.

GetStatusAsync(CancellationToken).note: Status arrives as WorkflowEvent::Status on the stream or via into_run().state(); no query on the live stream.

SendResponseAsync(ExternalResponse).note: Responses go to WorkflowRun::send_response after into_run(); events after the response are not streamed.

WatchStreamAsync(bool, CancellationToken.note: The stream yields events until the run halts (including on pending requests); no flag to block on pending requests.

mapping.note: Workflows emit no warning events; warnings go to tracing only.

Checkpoint.note: Superstep checkpoints are saved but not reported on the completion event.

HasPendingMessages.note: No pending-messages flag is reported per superstep.

HasPendingRequests.note: No pending-requests flag on superstep events; Status(IdleWithPendingRequests) reports it at halt.

InstantiatedExecutors.note: No instantiated-executors tracking; executors are pre-built Arc<dyn Executor> instances.

StepNumber.note: The step number is the usize payload of the SuperStepStarted and SuperStepCompleted variants.

mapping.note: No superstep start diagnostics type.

HasExternalMessages.note: No external-messages flag on superstep start.

SendingExecutors.note: Sending executors per superstep are not reported.

mapping.note: SuperStepStarted(usize) marks the start of a superstep.

StartInfo.note: SuperStepStarted carries only the step number, no start diagnostics.
